set.body:
Scope: modules/surface geometry/domain/data types; ../mesh4s and ../locus4s.

Deliverable: Replace the parallel TriangleMesh/topology/domain representation with mesh4s-backed neuro-surface composition. Share topology across compatible white/pial/inflated/spherical realizations.

Acceptance:
- One topology/domain owner preserves vertex/face IDs and exact ordering through field attachment and serialization.
- Wrong topology/domain attachment is rejected; alternate realizations have explicit identity/alignment tests.
- Hot renderer/kernel access remains primitive and bounded; no per-element wrappers or mandatory whole-buffer copies.

Apply the shared migration and verification requirements in eco-unification.
set.title: U3: Adopt mesh4s topology, realizations and locus fields
